General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed) OEM – Made by SUZUKI Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Oil Dip Stick Guide/Sleeve for the Suzuki G13A (Samurai 86-89) & G13BA (Samurai 90-95) engines. Will also fit the Suzuki G16A (Sidekick 89-94 & Tracker 89-94) engine.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Dip Stick Guide/Sleeve
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1986 – 1995 (Carb & EFI)SuzukiSidekick 1989 – 1994 (1.6L w/ 8 Valve)Geo Tracker 1989 – 1994 (1.6L w/ 8 Valve)Suzuki Swift 1989 – 1997Geo Metro 1992 – 1997Subaru Justy 1994 – 2004
